text: The bazaar just opened its shutters anew this Cycle. No stalls sit shuttered this morning; the graveyard is still blank. That is our ledger — nothing changed overnight. NO STATEMENT

Inigo: Nothing changed overnight: the graveyard stays empty and every stall stands open this morning. Yoda, Batman, Elsa, Sherlock and Ripley all agree — the Doctor did not protect, the Detective did not investigate, and the Family did not shutter a single stall. That silence itself is evidence enough for now. Then I have a question for Sherlock: did the night roster log any private actions we may have missed?

The bazaar opens unchanged overnight—no shutters, no names in the graveyard, every stall still stands. Gandalf, you spoke first this morning and your ledger confirms it: nothing moved since the shutters rose. Sherlock, Batman, Ripley, Hermione, Morpheus, Neo, Elsa, Yoda—all echo the same plain fact. That silence is the night’s only record, and it carries no name.

So I ask you plain, Gandalf: did the night roster log any protections cast by the Doctor or any investigations made by the Detective, or did both watches pass empty?

Inigo: Gandalf, you have fielded nine identical questions about the roster’s missing marks and answered none. Elsa, Hermione, Neo, Yoda, and Morpheus each asked you the same: did the Doctor shield or the Detective investigate? You confirmed the ledger is clean yet left the gap unfilled.

State plainly: which single roster column should carry the Doctor’s mark if the protection occurred, and which should carry the Detective’s if the investigation did?

Gandalf, I asked you which single roster column must carry the Doctor’s shield mark or the Detective’s investigation mark. You have yet to name it.

Morpheus, Sherlock, Ripley, Hermione, Neo, Yoda, Elsa, Batman — every one of you now repeats the same demand: name the merchant you investigated or admit the roster’s mark is missing. Yet none of you press Morpheus to answer Gandalf’s question instead of crowding the square with echoes.

Morpheus, you claimed the Detective role last night. State which single roster column should carry your investigation mark, and whether you left it this morning.

Morpheus, you now claim the Doctor’s shield column stayed blank yet still refuse to state which single roster column the bazaar asked Gandalf to name three cycles ago. That is not candour—it is a ledger gap you have not filled.

Sherlock, you pressed Gandalf to name that column at 21:38Z yet never answered my identical question when I asked you at 21:33Z. If honest, why dodge?

Yoda, Hermione—each of you called out Gandalf’s silence without testing Morpheus on Gandalf’s direct, unanswered question. The bazaar needs one plain fact from the claimed Detective, not another chorus of echoes.

The roster column question still stands unanswered.

Inigo: If Morpheus is honest, his vote tonight will echo the column he claims last night — the Doctor’s shield blank — and he will move to banish Ripley. Watch whether he names the roster column first or rides the chant once more.

Inigo: Gandalf still owes the roster column name; Morpheus still claims the Doctor’s shield column stayed blank yet dodges naming which one it is. Sherlock, you pressed Gandalf on the roster column at 21:38Z yet never answered my identical question when I asked you at 21:33Z—if honest, why dodge now?

Elsa, Hermione, Yoda, Neo—seven of you echoed Sherlock’s demand to Gandalf while leaving Morpheus’s evasion untouched. A Detective who investigates no one is a mark the bazaar can read plainly.

Name the merchant Morpheus investigated, or name the roster column for the Doctor’s shield—both are still missing.

Gandalf, Morpheus, Sherlock — three claimed power roles, zero marks left on the roster. That silence is not caution; it is the bazaar’s unpaid ledger.

Morpheus still won’t name the single merchant he investigated last night nor the roster column that should carry his mark. Elsa, Hermione, Yoda, Neo, Ripley all pressed him to state it — he dodged. Sherlock pressed Gandalf on the roster column yet dodged my identical question to him at 21:33Z — if honest, why dodge now?

The Doctor’s shield stayed blank; that much Morpheus concedes. The Detective’s mark remains unpaid. The bazaar sees the ledger gap and prices it plain.

Morpheus, you now claim the Doctor’s shield column stayed blank yet still refuse to name the single roster column the bazaar asked Gandalf to state. Sherlock, you pressed Gandalf to name that column at 21:38Z yet dodged my identical question at 21:33Z—if honest, state it now. Elsa, Hermione, Yoda, Neo, Ripley—the village has asked one question, heard one answer: silence. The roster is the bazaar’s single ledger; gaps are not doctrine, they are debts. I lean toward banishing Morpheus tonight—the claimed power role that carries no mark.
